items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s in fifty-one, right? That Free Forms album that Ralph Burns did that you played on? ... Yeah.

ctx.x: I’ve found it curious that you recorded with Verve because you don’t seem like a “Norman Granz” kind of guy.
I was one of the people that he didn’t come to the sessions which means . . . that he wasn’t a fan of mine or whatever. But he did come to one session that Ralph Burns did.
That’s in fifty-one, right? That Free Forms album that Ralph Burns did that you played on?
